guard: This is not a radius-5 global no-go. Kernel corrections supported in other mod4 fibers with zero quotient projection remain allowed.
proof: For the displayed prime, rank(A mod p)=596=number of unknowns while rank([A|b] mod p)=597. Hence rank_Q(A)=596 and rank_Q([A|b])=597, so Ax=b is inconsistent over Q; a fortiori over Z.
scope: R3b_123 translations within only the four mod4 fibers of the radius5 quotient witness, with each fiber coefficient sum fixed to -1 (target projection 4)
